searchText: i'd lean towards what makes the spec simpler although if there is strong demand from a majority of CL teams to unify the queue then lets do it i'm also going to use this channel as a sort of "withdrawals interop" until we need a separate one ideally we can get a cross-client testnet w/ just withdrawals working by EOY <@539495253418180618> I came here to post precisely the opposite view to you for the same arguments. The proposed change is simpler than the current implementation. We need to implement a sweep anyway for partial withrawals. So putting all withdrawals in the same footing has less cognitive cost and is simpler to reason both at the spec and production level. Having said so, I would favor any decision on this, be it implementing it or not, rather than delaying. I'm about to implement this in prysm tonight since I got the feeling that we had a slight majority leaning towards implementing it. But now I'm not sure <@755590043632140352> if we didn't make the change, would prysm be ready _right now_ or are there still features to build out? i mainly want to do what is fastest for everyone 🙂 tracking client progress here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ralexstokes/SyDqVjr4i if you see your client has information missing, please coordinate w/ me to update the list cc <@524738020033691659> (or anyone from besu), and also are there any erigon devs here? Oh it would be slightly slower cause I'd need to implement the current method that requires two different logics, but either way not much of a difference We currently have the structures implemented. A bunch of helpers. We are missing Epoch transition, state transition and RPC endpoints. The latter may take some time. The former is just a few hours after a decision is made Can we put this into the CL call agenda so as to get to consensus by then at least? well i'd hope there is consensus before then 😅 can discuss on ACD this Thursday, or we wait till the CL call For Besu we have a WIP PR: https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/4552

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: <@539495253418180618> I came here to post precisely the opposite view to you for the same arguments. The proposed change is simpler than the current implementation. We need to implement a sweep anyway for partial withrawals. So putting all withdrawals in the same footing has less cognitive cost and is simpler to reason both at the spec and production level. Having said so, I would favor any decision on this, be it implementing it or not, rather than delaying. I'm about to implement this in prysm tonight since I got the feeling that we had a slight majority leaning towards implementing it. But now I'm not sure
